summary: Full E2E validation of DOCUMENTS MOBILE SCANNER V2 on LogiTrak (React + FastAPI, tenant default & client-test-e2e). Backend RBAC/tenant isolation + full frontend flow (import → analyze → review → validate with real Claude OCR), multi-pages editing, double-submit guard, A→B state isolation, /scan fallback URL (direct, invalid type, unknown id, post-login return, url-clean), read-only redirect and mobile responsive 390x844 — ALL PASS. 0 console errors on main path (one favicon-style 404 in a stray load, non-blocking). Real camera stream (getUserMedia) and real hub Android WebView = NOT TESTED (out of automation scope).
critical_code_review_comments: ScanDocumentDialog.analyze() correctly resets busyRef only when generation matches (gen === genRef.current) — the anti-double-submit guard and the anti-obsolete-result guard are correct. Verified: two rapid clicks on scan-analyze-btn produce exactly ONE POST /api/vehicles/{id}/documents/scan.

ScanPage: user?.role === 'read_only' → <Navigate to='/vehicules' replace/> executes BEFORE the useQuery mounts fully, but useQuery is called unconditionally above (hooks order OK). Verified: RO on /scan/{realVid} lands on /vehicules with no console error.
Login.safeFrom sanitization (startsWith('/') && !startsWith('//') && !=='/login') covers the main open-redirect vectors; verified end-to-end that /scan/{vid}?type=assurance is honored post-login.

ScanDocumentDialog.reset() is called from close(o=false), which also fires initialStep re-derivation via useState initializer (frozen at mount). Because reset() sets step to initialStep captured from mount, if a caller mutates askType/forcedType between opens without unmounting, the step reset may not reflect the new mode — acceptable here because ScanPage remounts on route change and DocumentsTab uses key-less mount per open.

Backend POST /api/vehicles/{id}/documents/scan: 403 for read_only, 404 for cross-tenant, 4xx for non-supported extension, 4xx for >8 files — all confirmed via /app/backend/tests/test_scan_v2_readonly.py (4/4 PASS in 6s).
